HOW TO USE YOUR PLAN

This nutrition system is engineered to seamlessly integrate into your daily life. Adhere to these three operational principles.
01
Follow the day's structure
Use the listed meals and portions as your daily foundation.
02
Use a swap when needed
Approved exchanges give you flexibility without turning the plan into guesswork.
03
Consistency beats perfection
Follow the structure most of the time and use the plan as a repeatable system.
Weekly Preparation Checklist
1. Batch-cook staple stews (Shiro, Misir, Chicken) in advance for 2-3 days.
2. Boil eggs in advance for zero-friction morning prep.
3. Wash and portion fresh vegetables to prevent daily cooking friction.

Measurement Principles
Every meal shows exact grams together with a familiar household portion where the source dataset supports one.

• Palm: Standard measure for meat/poultry portioning.
• Cup: Standard measure for cooked grains and legumes.
• Rolled Injera: 1 medium rolled piece represents ~120 grams.
